detail.longDescription: 🐧 SIGINT // Linux Watch — 2026-09-23 A KVM bug on ARM64 lets guests read-write host memory and, with nested virt enabled, potentially escape to the host. Ubuntu 26.04's AWS/Azure/GCP kernels are named, so patch before your 'isolated' VMs start comparing notes. 🔗 https:// thehackernews.com/2026/09/new- linux-kernel-flaw-gives-arm64-kvm.html # Linux # OpenSource # FOSS
